narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Twenty two times three, twice over, makes one hundred thirty two.
<bookmark mark='half'/>Each triangle fills only half of the rectangle around it.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Without the halves, the answer is double the real area.
removed_beats.on_screen: the hint card leaves; Chintu's bubble shows 22 × 3 + 22 × 3 = 132; each triangle is shown as half of a rectangle; the bubble is struck in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='c1'/>To check, make sure each triangle used half of base times height.
<bookmark mark='c2'/>Then redo it as half of the diagonal times the two heights added.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor; two check lines appear: each triangle uses a half; redo it as half of the diagonal times both heights

old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu multiplies twenty two by three for each triangle and adds, giving one hundred thirty two. He forgot the half for each triangle.
